source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 27 exercise hal (PDF 175-177): MCQs jawab aur wajah ke saath, short, construction response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, farq tables mein, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 27 (Biochemistry) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, construction response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab diye gaye hain, farq wale sawal tables mein. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I. Glucose is a building block for all, except:
(Glucose in sab ki ikaai hai, siwaye:)
blocks.explanation: Cellulose, glycogen aur starch sab glucose units se bane hain (27.1). Inulin zyada tar fructose units se bana polysaccharide hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
II. Which one of the following is not an aldose?
(In mein se kaun aldose nahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldose mein aldehyde group (–CHO) hota hai aur ketose mein ketone group (C=O). Glucose aldose hai jabke fructose ketose hai (27.1).

blocks.prompt:
III. Which one of the following element is not present in all proteins?
(Kaun sa element har protein mein mojood nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Har amino acid mein C, H, O aur N (–NH₂ aur –COOH) hote hain, is liye har protein mein yeh hain. Sulphur sirf un proteins mein hota hai jin mein sulphur wale amino acids hon, misal jahan disulphide bridges bante hain (27.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
IV. In DNA, the linkages between different nitrogenous bases are:
(DNA mein mukhtalif nitrogenous bases ke darmiyan kaun si linkage hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono chains ke bases kamzor hydrogen bonds se juray hote hain: A aur T ke beech do, G aur C ke beech teen (27.5.1).

blocks.prompt:
V. Which one of the following nitrogenous bases is not common to RNA and DNA?
(Kaun sa nitrogenous base RNA aur DNA dono mein mushtarik nahi?)
blocks.explanation: DNA mein A, G, C aur T hain; RNA mein A, G, C aur U (27.5.1, 27.5.2). Uracil sirf RNA mein hai, is liye dono mein mushtarik nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (c) mein 'thiamine' chhapa hai jo vitamin B₁ hai, base nahi; sahi base thymine hai. Thymine parhein to (c) bhi sahi hoga kyunke thymine sirf DNA mein hai. Chhape hue options mein wazeh jawab uracil (d) hai.

blocks.prompt:
VI. Waxes are the esters of:
(Waxes kin ke esters hain?)
blocks.explanation: Waxes lambi fatty acid chains aur lambi chain wale alcohols ke esters hain, misal beeswax (27.4.1).

blocks.prompt:
VII. A cell membrane is made up of:
(Cell membrane kis cheez se bani hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani mein phospholipids do tehon wali sheet (bilayer) banate hain, polar sir bahar aur non-polar dumen andar; yahi har cell membrane ki banawat hai (27.4.2).

blocks.prompt:
VIII. The bonds in protein structure that are not broken on denaturation.
(Protein ke structure mein kaun se bonds denaturation par nahi toot-te?)
blocks.explanation: Denaturation (garmi, pH ki tabdeeli) kamzor bonds jaise hydrogen bonds tor deti hai aur chains khul jati hain, misal anday ki safedi sakht ho jati hai (27.2.1). Primary structure ke mazboot covalent peptide bonds qaim rehte hain.

blocks.prompt:
IX. The backbone of nucleic acid structure is constructed by:
(Nucleic acid ka backbone kis se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleotides sugars ke 3' aur 5' carbons ke darmiyan phosphodiester linkages se jurte hain, aur sugar-phosphate ka backbone banta hai (27.5).

blocks.prompt:
X. Which element prevents the development of tooth decay:
(Kaun sa element daanton ki kharabi (tooth decay) ko rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fluorine, fluoride ki soorat mein (micro-mineral), daanton ke enamel ko mazboot karta hai aur kharabi se bachata hai (chapter se aage). Calcium aur phosphorus haddiyan aur daant banate hain lekin khaas tor par kharabi nahi rokte.

blocks.prompt:
a) What role does glycogen play in the human body?
Insani jism mein glycogen ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Glycogen (animal starch) glucose ko zakheera karne ki shakal hai. Zaid glucose jigar (liver) aur muscles mein glycogen ban kar jama hota hai; jab jism ko energy chahiye to yeh toot kar glucose banta hai aur energy aur khoon ka glucose (70-110 mg/dL) barqarar rakhta hai (27.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
b) Point out the main structural difference between the compounds in each of the following pairs.
i) Glucose and fructose
Glucose aur fructose mein bunyadi structural farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono hexoses hain aur formula C₆H₁₂O₆ hai (isomers).

rows: Aldose: C1 par aldehyde group (–CHO)
Ketose: C2 par ketone group (C=O)
Chhe kono wali ring (pyranose)
Paanch kono wali ring (furanose)
Khoon ki shakar (blood sugar)
Phalon ki shakar, phalon aur shehad mein zyada

blocks.prompt:
ii) Cellulose and starch
Cellulose aur starch mein structural farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono glucose ke polymers hain, (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ; farq glycosidic link ki qisam aur shakhon (branching) mein hai.

rows: Glucose units β-links se juri
Glucose units α-links se juri (α-1,4; amylopectin mein α-1,6 bhi)
Lambi baghair shakh chains (2500 tak glucose units)
Amylose baghair shakh; amylopectin bohat shakhdaar
Chains mazboot hydrogen bonds se juri: sakht, paani mein na ghulne wali
Amylopectin ghulne wala, amylose na ghulne wala
Paudon ki cell walls ka structural maadda
Paudon ka energy zakheera

blocks.prompt:
iii) Competetive and non-competitive inhibition
Competitive aur non-competitive inhibition mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono inhibitors substrate ko active site par judne se rokte hain (27.3.2).

rows: Inhibitor ki shakal substrate jaisi
Inhibitor substrate jaisa nahi
Active site par jurta hai aur substrate se muqabla karta hai
Kisi aur jagah jurta hai aur active site ki shakal badal deta hai
Reversible (wapas hone wala)
Irreversible; enzyme hamesha ke liye nakara
Misal malonate, succinate dehydrogenase ko rokta hai
Misal penicillin transpeptidase ko rokti hai; zehar

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Hissa iii) mein 'Competetive' chhapa hai; sahi lafz competitive hai.

blocks.prompt:
iv) Glycolipids and lipoprotein
Glycolipids aur lipoprotein mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono compound lipids hain: lipids jin ke saath koi aur group jura ho (27.4.2).

rows: Lipid jis ke saath carbohydrate (shakar) groups juray hon
Lipid aur protein ka majmua (complex)
Zyada tar nervous tissue mein
Khoon mein
Tissue (membrane) ki banawat ka hissa
Khoon mein hydrophobic lipids (cholesterol, triglycerides) le jate hain

blocks.prompt:
c) Which class of biomolecule contains each of the following linkages? Describe the function of each linkage.
i) Glycosidic ii) Peptide iii) Ester iv) Phosphodiester
Yeh linkages kis biomolecule mein hain aur har aik ka kaam kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
i) Glycosidic (C–O–C): carbohydrates; monosaccharide units ko jor kar di- aur polysaccharides banata hai (sucrose, starch, cellulose).
ii) Peptide (–CO–NH–): proteins; amino acids ko polypeptide chains mein jorta hai aur primary structure tay karta hai.
iii) Ester (–COO–): lipids; fatty acids ko glycerol ya lambe alcohol se jorta hai (fats, oils, waxes, phospholipids).
iv) Phosphodiester: nucleic acids; sugars ke 3' aur 5' carbons ko phosphate se jor kar mazboot sugar-phosphate backbone banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
d) How the tertiary structure of proteins is formed?
Proteins ka tertiary structure kaise banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Polypeptide chain (apne α-helix aur β-sheets ke saath) side chains (R-groups) ke darmiyan interactions ki wajah se aik khaas 3D shakal mein tah ho jati hai: hydrogen bonds, ionic bonds, hydrophobic interactions aur disulphide bridges. Aksar is se globular protein banta hai, misal active site wala enzyme (27.2.1).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Protein ki chaar satahen yaad rakhein: primary = amino acids ki tarteeb (peptide bonds); secondary = backbone ke hydrogen bonds se α-helix ya β-sheet; tertiary = R-groups ke interactions se poori 3D shakal; quaternary = do ya zyada chains ka milna.

blocks.prompt:
e) In what way fats and oils are different?
Fats aur oils mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono triglycerides hain (glycerol aur teen fatty acids ke esters); farq fatty acids ki qisam mein hai (27.4.1).

rows: Saturated fatty acids (C=C nahi)
Unsaturated fatty acids (aik ya zyada C=C)
Kamre ke darja hararat par thos (solid)
Kamre ke darja hararat par maaya (liquid)
Zyada tar janwaron se, misal ghee
Zyada tar paudon se, misal vegetable oil

blocks.prompt:
f) Describe the structure of steroids. Write a note on the functions of cholesterol.
Steroids ka structure bayan karein. Cholesterol ke kaam par note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Structure: steroids fatty acids se nahi bante lekin lipids jaisi khususiyat rakhte hain. In mein steroid nucleus hai: teen cyclohexane rings (A, B, C) aur aik cyclopentane ring (D) aapas mein juri hui; aksar mein –OH group hai (sterols), misal cholesterol (27.4.3).
Cholesterol: aik sterol jo cell membranes ka hissa hai aur is se bile salts, vitamin D aur steroid hormones bante hain (chapter se aage); khoon mein yeh lipoproteins ke zariye jata hai (27.4.2).

blocks.prompt:
g) Describe the mechanism of enzyme action.
Enzyme ke kaam karne ka tareeqa (mechanism) bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Substrate (S) enzyme (E) ki active site mein fit ho kar aarzi enzyme-substrate complex banata hai; substrate products (P) mein badalta hai jo alag ho jate hain, aur enzyme waisa hi reh kar naye substrate ke liye azad hota hai (27.3):
E + S → ES → E + P
Ise lock and key model (Emil Fischer, 1894) se samjha jata hai: enzyme = taala, substrate = chaabi.

blocks.prompt:
h) Why does an enzyme catalyze a reaction of only a specific substrate?
Enzyme sirf aik khaas substrate ka reaction hi kyun tez karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Enzyme ki active site ki aik munfarid (unique) shakal hai jis mein sirf aik khaas substrate fit hota hai, jaise chaabi apne taale mein (lock and key model). Doosre molecules fit nahi hote, is liye un par asar nahi hota (27.3).

blocks.prompt:
i) Name different RNAs and discuss their function.
RNA ki mukhtalif qismon ke naam aur kaam batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Messenger RNA (mRNA): nucleus mein DNA se copy kiya gaya genetic naqsha ribosomes tak le jata hai.
2. Ribosomal RNA (rRNA): ribosome banane mein madad karta hai, jahan proteins bante hain.
3. Transfer RNA (tRNA): amino acids lata hai aur mRNA ke bases ki tarteeb ko protein ke amino acids ki tarteeb mein badalta hai (27.5.2).

blocks.prompt:
j) What are some sources of potassium, iron, calcium, magnesium and zinc in our diet?
Hamari ghiza mein potassium, iron, calcium, magnesium aur zinc ke kuch zariye batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Potassium: namak, gosht, samandari khana, phalon ke juice, sabziyan, daalen.
Iron: kaleji, gosht, anday ki zardi, mewe (nuts), saboot anaaj, phaliyan, matar, daalen.
Calcium: doodh aur dairy cheezen, hari sabziyan, broccoli, salmon, sardines, phaliyan.
Magnesium: hari pattedaar sabziyan, mewe aur saboot anaaj (chapter se aage).
Zinc: gosht, samandari khana, saboot anaaj (Table 27.1).

blocks.prompt:
k) What is the role of iron in the body?
Jism mein iron ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Iron khoon ke surkh khaliyon mein haemoglobin aur muscles mein myoglobin banane ke liye zaroori hai; yeh oxygen le jate hain (Table 27.1).

blocks.prompt:
l) How enzyme inhibitors are important in our body and medicine?
Enzyme inhibitors hamare jism aur dawaon mein kyun ahem hain?
blocks.explanation: Bohat si dawaen aur antibiotics enzyme inhibitors ki tarah kaam karti hain: penicillin bacteria ke enzyme transpeptidase ko hamesha ke liye rok deti hai, cell wall nahi banti aur bacteria mar jate hain (27.3.2). Competitive inhibitors jaise malonate dikhate hain ke milta julta molecule enzyme ko band kar sakta hai. Jism mein inhibitors enzymes ki raftaar control karte hain (chapter se aage), lekin zehar irreversible inhibitors ban kar sakht bimari ya maut ka sabab ban sakte hain.

blocks.text: Q3. Construction Response Questions (soch kar banaye jane wale jawab)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Heading mein 'Construction Response Questions' chhapa hai; matlab Constructed Response Questions hai, jaise baqi chapters mein.

blocks.prompt:
a. Why does the digestive enzyme pepsin have an optimum pH of 2?
Hazme ka enzyme pepsin ka optimum pH 2 kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Pepsin maide (stomach) mein kaam karta hai jahan hydrochloric acid pH ko taqreeban 2 rakhta hai (chapter se aage). Is ki active site sirf isi pH par sahi shakal mein hoti hai; doosre pH par tertiary structure ke ionic aur hydrogen bonds badal jate hain, active site bigar jati hai aur enzyme nakara ho jata hai (27.3.1).

blocks.prompt:
b. How condensation of sugars and condensation of amino acid are same?
Sugars ki condensation aur amino acids ki condensation kis tarah aik jaisi hain?
blocks.explanation:
Dono condensation reactions hain: do units covalent bond se jurti hain aur paani ka aik molecule nikalta hai; yahi dohrane se polymer banta hai.
Sugars: –OH + HO– → glycosidic link C–O–C + H₂O (glucose + fructose → sucrose; bohat se glucose → starch, cellulose) (27.1)
Amino acids: –COOH + H₂N– → peptide link –CO–NH– + H₂O (polypeptides, proteins) (27.2.1)
Dono hydrolysis se ulat jati hain.

blocks.prompt:
c. Why is cholesterol included in the lipid family?
Cholesterol ko lipid family mein kyun shamil kiya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Lipids ko un ki khususiyat se pehchana jata hai: yeh hydrophobic (paani se door bhagne wale) hain, paani mein nahi ghulte lekin organic solvents mein ghul jate hain. Cholesterol, aik steroid, fatty acids se nahi banta lekin is mein yahi lipid jaisi khususiyat hain, is liye yeh derived lipid hai (27.4, 27.4.3).

blocks.prompt:
d. Why fats and oils are also called triacylglycerols?
Fats aur oils ko triacylglycerols bhi kyun kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Har molecule aik glycerol aur teen fatty acids ka ester hai: glycerol ke teeno –OH groups par aik aik acyl group (R–CO–) laga hai. Glycerol par teen (tri) acyl groups, is liye naam triacylglycerol (triglyceride) (27.4.1).

blocks.prompt:
e. How hydrogen bonding is important in the double helix of DNA?
DNA ke double helix mein hydrogen bonding kyun ahem hai?
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonds double helix ki dono chains ko base pairs ke zariye jore rakhte hain: A, T se do hydrogen bonds se aur G, C se teen se jurta hai (27.5.1). Har bond kamzor hai, is liye replication aur transcription ke liye chains alag ho sakti hain, lekin bohat saare bond mil kar helix ko mazboot rakhte hain. Kyunke sirf A–T aur G–C fit hote hain, bases ki tarteeb durust copy hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
f. If the sequence T-A-C-C-G-A located on one strand of DNA, what sequence would be seen opposite to it on the other strand?
Agar DNA ki aik strand par T-A-C-C-G-A ho to doosri strand par saamne kya tarteeb hogi?
blocks.explanation:
A hamesha T ke saath aur G hamesha C ke saath jurta hai (27.5.1):
Di gayi strand: T-A-C-C-G-A
Saamne wali strand: A-T-G-G-C-T

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Saamne wali strand likhne ka asool: har T ke saamne A, har A ke saamne T, har C ke saamne G aur har G ke saamne C likhein. Jawab ki dobara jaanch: dono strands mein A ki tadaad doosri ke T ke barabar honi chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Classify and describe the structure of polysaccharides.
Polysaccharides ki darja bandi karein aur un ka structure bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Polysaccharides bare molecules hain jin mein bohat se monosaccharide units glycosidic links se juri hoti hain, aam formula (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ; hydrolysis par monosaccharides dete hain. Misal: starch, glycogen, cellulose aur pectin (27.1).
Kaam ke lehaz se darja bandi:
A. Zakheera karne wale (storage) polysaccharides
1. Starch: paudon ka bara energy zakheera (aaloo, chawal, anaaj), glucose units se bana. Is ke do hisse hain:
• Amylose: glucose ki lambi baghair shakh chains, α-1,4 glycosidic links; paani mein nahi ghulta.
• Amylopectin: ghana, bohat shakhdaar; chains mein α-1,4 aur shakhon par α-1,6 links; paani mein ghul jata hai.
2. Glycogen (animal starch): glucose ka polymer jo jigar aur muscles mein jama hota hai; banawat amylopectin jaisi lekin us se bhi zyada shakhdaar.
B. Structural (dhancha banane wale) polysaccharides
3. Cellulose: paudon ki cell walls ka bunyadi maadda; 2500 tak glucose units ki lambi baghair shakh chains jo β-links se juri hain. Chains aapas mein mazboot hydrogen bonds banati hain, is liye cellulose sakht aur paani mein na ghulne wala hai. Khane mein yeh fibre hai jo meday (gut) ki sehat behtar karta hai.
Shakal ke lehaz se: baghair shakh (amylose, cellulose) aur shakhdaar (amylopectin, glycogen).

blocks.prompt:
Q5. How the structure of proteins support its function. Describe at each structure level.
Proteins ka structure un ke kaam mein kaise madad karta hai? Har satah par bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Protein ka kaam us ki theek 3D shakal par munhasir hai, jo chaar satahon mein banti hai (27.2.1):
1. Primary structure: amino acids ki khaas seedhi tarteeb jo peptide bonds se juri hai. Yahi tay karti hai ke chain kaise tah hogi aur is tarah kaam kya hoga; misal albumin (taqreeban 400 amino acids) aur insulin ko apni theek tarteeb chahiye. Aik amino acid badalne se bhi kaam bigar sakta hai, misal sickle cell anaemia mein ghair mamooli haemoglobin.
2. Secondary structure: backbone ke C=O aur N–H groups ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se baqaida namoone bante hain: α-helix (aik hi chain mein bonds, spring jaisi, misal keratin) aur β-pleated sheet (saath wali strands ke beech bonds, misal silk fibroin). Yeh mazbooti aur lachak dete hain.
3. Tertiary structure: R-groups ke interactions se chain 3D shakal mein tah hoti hai: hydrogen bonds, ionic bonds, hydrophobic interactions aur disulphide bridges. Enzymes mein is se theek active site banti hai jo substrate ko pakadti hai; koi bhi tabdeeli activity ko mutasir karti hai.
4. Quaternary structure: do ya zyada tah shuda chains (subunits) unhi interactions se aapas mein milti hain.
Shakal aur kaam: fibrous proteins (lambi, mutawazi chains, hydrogen ya disulphide bonds se juri; na ghulne wale, mazboot) structural hain, misal collagen, keratin, myosin; globular proteins (gol) kaam karne wale hain jaise enzymes aur hormones. Keratin disulphide bonds ki wajah se aasaani se denature nahi hota.
Jab garmi ya pH yeh bonds tor de (denaturation) to shakal aur kaam dono khatam, misal garam karne par anday ki safedi sakht ho jati hai aur lemon juice se casein jam jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Write an account of classification of lipids with suitable examples.
Lipids ki darja bandi misalon ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Lipids hydrophobic (paani se door) compounds hain jo organic solvents mein ghulte hain; yeh polymers nahi. Inhein chemical banawat ke lehaz se taqseem kiya jata hai (27.4):
1. Simple lipids: fatty acids aur alcohols ke esters.
• Fats aur oils (triglycerides): aik glycerol + teen fatty acids. Fats (saturated fatty acids) thos hain, misal ghee; oils (unsaturated) maaya hain, misal vegetable oil. Yeh energy jama karte hain aur jism ko garam rakhte hain (insulation).
• Waxes: lambi fatty acid chains aur lambe alcohols ke esters; paani ko door rakhne wali tehen, misal beeswax, paudon ka wax.
2. Compound (complex) lipids: aise esters jin ke alcohol par koi izafi group ho.
• Phospholipids: glycerol + do fatty acids + phosphate group; polar sir aur non-polar dumen; cell membranes ki bilayer banate hain.
• Glycolipids: carbohydrate groups wale lipids, zyada tar nervous tissue mein.
• Lipoproteins: lipid aur protein ke complexes jo khoon mein cholesterol aur triglycerides le jate hain.
3. Derived lipids: simple aur compound lipids ki hydrolysis se bane products jin mein lipid ki khususiyat hon, misal fatty acids, glycerol, steroids aur fat mein ghulne wale vitamins (A, D, E, K).
• Steroids: chaar juri rings (A, B, C chhe kono wali; D paanch kono wali), misal cholesterol, bile salts, vitamin D, steroid hormones.
• Terpenes: paudon ke hydrocarbons jo isoprene units se bante hain, misal limonene; 40 carbon wale carotenoids kehlate hain (27.4.3).

blocks.prompt:
Q7. What are nucleic acids? Describe the roll of DNA and RNA in the protein synthesis.
Nucleic acids kya hain? Protein synthesis mein DNA aur RNA ka kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nucleic acids bare biomolecules hain jo genetic maloomat jama aur muntaqil karte hain. Yeh nucleotides (sugar + phosphate + nitrogenous base) ke polymers hain jo sugars ke 3' aur 5' carbons ke darmiyan phosphodiester links se jurte hain; DNA mein sugar deoxyribose aur RNA mein ribose hai (27.5).
DNA ka kirdar: nucleus mein DNA proteins ka coded naqsha (blueprint) hai; har gene, jo DNA ka aik hissa hai, aik protein ki hidayat rakhta hai jo chaar bases ki tarteeb mein likhi hai (teen bases ka codon aik amino acid batata hai). DNA apni copy banata hai (replication) taake har naye cell ko poori hidayat mile (27.5.1).
RNA ka kirdar aur protein synthesis ke steps (27.5.3):
1. Transcription: DNA gene ki hidayat nucleus mein mRNA mein copy hoti hai (RNA polymerase se).
2. Mukammal mRNA DNA se alag ho kar cytoplasm mein jata hai aur ribosomes (jo rRNA se bante hain) se jurta hai.
3. Translation: ribosome par mRNA ka code parha jata hai; tRNA mutabiq amino acids lata hai jo mRNA ke bases ki tarteeb mein lagte hain.
4. Amino acids peptide bonds se jurte hain; polypeptide chain barhti hai yahan tak ke mukammal protein ban jata hai.
Maloomat ka bahao: DNA → (transcription) mRNA → (translation) protein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Q7 mein 'the roll of DNA and RNA' chhapa hai; sahi lafz role (kirdar) hai.

items: MCQs ke jawab: I c, II d, III d, IV b, V d, VI d, VII a, VIII b, IX c, X a.
Linkages: carbohydrates = glycosidic, proteins = peptide, lipids = ester, nucleic acids = phosphodiester.
Kitab ki ghaltiyan: MCQ V(c) 'thiamine' (thymine), Q2(b)(iii) 'Competetive', Q3 heading 'Construction Response', Q7 'roll' (role).
